name: baton
description: Context budget guard and handoff relay: measures real context use per model request, stops subagents that run too long or too big, and hands work over to a fresh session before the main agent drowns.

mainWrapUpPercent.title: Main agent wrap-up at %
mainWrapUpPercent.description: Context fill (percent of the window) at which the main agent is told to wrap up and write a handoff.

agentMaxPercent.title: Subagent context limit %
agentMaxPercent.description: A subagent whose context passes this percent is stopped and asked for a handoff of the remaining work.

agentMaxMinutes.title: Subagent time limit (minutes)
agentMaxMinutes.description: A subagent running longer than this is stopped and asked for a handoff of the remaining work.
